definitions.explanation: A Japanese dish of seafood or vegetables coated in a light batter and deep-fried until crispy.

examples.japanese: ⟦エビ→海老：02272_ebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天|てん}ぷら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like shrimp tempura the best.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Tempura is delicious when freshly fried.
examples.notes: 揚げたて means just fried/freshly fried

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{天|てん}つゆ→天つゆ：28739_tentsuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つけて→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Eat tempura by dipping it in tentsuyu sauce.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷら⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Also written as {天麩羅|てんぷら} or {天婦羅|てんぷら}. The word likely derives from Portuguese 'tempero' (seasoning) or 'tempora' (Lenten period).

Common ingredients:
- ⟦エビ→海老：02272_ebi⟧/⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧ (shrimp)
- ⟦イカ→烏賊：04319_ika⟧ (squid)
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (fish)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: ⟦なす→ナス：11146_nasu⟧, ⟦かぼちゃ→かぼちゃ：10306_kabocha⟧, ⟦さつまいも→さつまいも：10339_satsumaimo⟧, ⟦しいたけ→シイタケ：10930_shiitake⟧, ⟦ししとう→ししとう：noentry⟧, ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧

The key to good tempura is light, crispy batter (⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧) made with cold water and minimal mixing. Served with:
- ⟦{天|てん}つゆ→天つゆ：28739_tentsuyu⟧ (dipping sauce)
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧ (grated daikon)
